name: @openmixture/studio
description: Independent OpenMixture Player consuming the packaged browser runtime

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.test:browser: npm run typecheck && vite build --mode browser-test && playwright test
scripts.test:materials: npm run typecheck && vite build --mode browser-test && node scripts/verify-materials.mjs
scripts.test:studio: npm run typecheck && vite build --mode browser-test && node scripts/verify-studio.mjs
